decisions.why: the division's own product names give explicit material evidence for more than one category — Medicom AssureTouch Ultra Tough Fully Textured Nitrile Medical Examination Gloves and four Ocean Pacific-branded Nitrile Medical Examination Gloves (Blue Lite, Intuition, Lab Master, Ninja) are nitrile examination gloves; Medicom SafeTouch EverStrong Vinyl Medical Examination Gloves is a vinyl examination glove; Vital Touch AMD Ritmed Powder Free Latex Surgical Gloves is explicitly a surgical (not examination) latex glove, matching the Ansell/Semperit precedent of filing sterile surgeon's gloves under theatres:glove rather than infection:latex
